body: Lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-06 23:32Z). On a mailbox read failing with 409 "no saved association for this caller and mailbox (home=local)", FIRST decode the caller's exact full locator (base64 JSON) and compare its id byte for byte with the id in the wake or list output. On 2026-11-06 Engram::Merger's failing locators had a correct prefix (mailbox-2112d813-13c9-44cb-) but a garbled tail, because the agent re-typed them. The mailbox was fine, and four sessions spent an hour on a phantom "lost association". The same happened on 2026-11-04 (correction 79e7f8d). Abbreviated ids such as "2112d813…" hide this. Tell agents to copy locators verbatim from wake or list output. Tracked fix: w-009fe89b37b8, an accurate "unknown mailbox id" message.
